name: v0.2.27
body:
Local MLX translation, bounded WebSocket sessions, and a security refresh of the locked dependencies.

## Added
- Local sentence translation on Apple Silicon through mlx-lm (`mlx-llm-mt` extra: Hunyuan-MT, TranslateGemma), with shared model weights and per-session languages and buffers. (#422, thanks @clkao)
- Simultaneous MLX translation with calibrated attention (AlignAtt commit policy), and the zh→en calibration for Hy-MT2 1.8B 8bit. (#423, #448, thanks @clkao)
- Per-session decoder context: a `context` query option on the native and Deepgram-compatible WebSockets, and the OpenAI-compatible REST `prompt` field now conditions the decoder. (#424)
- `--max-concurrent-sessions` (64 per worker by default) and `--session-idle-timeout` (60 s by default) for WebSocket sessions. Upgrades beyond the limit are refused with HTTP 403 before any decoder or FFmpeg process is created. (#465)

## Fixed
- Sortformer inference no longer blocks the event loop. (#461, thanks @guhyun9454)
- SimulStreaming reads the no-speech probability at the start-of-transcript token once the context buffer holds text. (#468, fixes #467 reported by @AuCourDe)
- Closing a translation no longer waits behind the inference it needs to interrupt. (#445)
- Final ASR output is no longer lost at the end of a stream, and decoder and diarization failures are reported to clients. (#440, #441)
- Sessions requesting another language on non-Whisper backends no longer fail at construction. (#439)
- Streaming queues are bounded, FFmpeg processes are reaped on disconnect, and failed requests no longer leave collector tasks running. (#432, #435)

## Maintenance and security
- Locked dependencies refreshed with the October security fixes (certifi, urllib3, filelock, fsspec, msgpack, Pillow, PyJWT, aiohttp and others), plus AnyIO and HTTPX2. Remaining blocked upgrades are listed in `docs/dependency-audit.md`. (#466, #472)
- Checkpoint loading is restricted to weights-only tensors. (#438)
- The `qwen3-vllm-metal` extra no longer pins the vllm-metal GitHub wheel, which was blocking Dependabot. Install vllm-metal with its official installer, then install the extra into that environment. (#473)
- Transport security documented for remote AlignAtt translation servers. (#469)
- Audio input and translation are separated from session orchestration. (#436)
- Benchmark reports are reproducible, keep failures, and pace audio without artificial EOF delays. (#437, #442, #443)
- CI, Docker and dependency updates. (#429, #430, #433, #457, #458, #470, #471)

## New contributors
- @clkao made their first contribution in #422.
- @guhyun9454 made their first contribution in #461.

**Full changelog**: https://github.com/QuentinFuxa/WhisperLiveKit/compare/v0.2.26...v0.2.27
